author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 12: Automated Nudge Target Selection
abstract:
This experiment innovates upon the 'Nudge and Refine' SOTA methodology (replicated in ID 847).
Instead of manually selecting a pair of circles to nudge, this script automates the target selection.
The hypothesis is that a data-driven approach to selecting the nudge target can outperform manual selection.
The script analyzes the base SOTA packing and selects the non-touching circle pair with the smallest 'slack' (distance - (r1+r2)) as the most promising target to encourage contact.
